name: Doomscroll Receipt
concept: Type how long you scroll per day. Get a printed-receipt style breakdown: per year, per decade, days of your life, and what a 30-min cut gives back. Designed to be screenshotted.
target_audience: Anyone with a phone, 16-45, global, English-first
utility: Concrete number for a vague feeling; a reason to change one habit
share_trigger: The receipt is a personal, slightly absurd artifact people want to show ('look at mine')
viral_mechanism: share card (PNG) + 'compare with a friend' link + result-based rank label
expected_value: high shareability, low utility depth; good first traffic engine
monetization_relation: support intent shown after the receipt, once value is delivered
notes: First drop. Must compete with later drops. Metrics decide: scale / iterate / pause / kill.

name: Subscription Lifetime Receipt
concept: Pick your subscriptions (streaming, music, cloud, gym, apps). See the true 1/5/10-year cost and what that money is in concrete things. Receipt format, shareable.
share_trigger: 'I pay HOW much for Netflix over 10 years?'
expected_value: high utility + high shareability; strong SEO ('subscription cost calculator')
notes: Next build candidate. Reuses receipt engine from DROP-001.

name: Weekends Left
concept: Enter your age. See the weekends you statistically have left, as a grid you can screenshot. Optional: weekends left with your parents / kids at home.
share_trigger: the grid image is striking and personal
viral_mechanism: generated image + 'send to someone you should see more'
expected_value: very high emotional share rate; must stay non-morbid and non-medical
notes: Use public life-expectancy averages with clear disclaimer: statistics, not predictions.

name: Your Phone's Birthday Card
concept: How many times have you unlocked your phone since you got it? Enter unlocks/day and years owned; get an absurd milestone card ('you have unlocked your phone more times than there are people in Iceland').
expected_value: fun but shallow; could be a variant of DROP-001

name: Coffee vs Car
concept: Enter a small daily habit spend. See what it compounds to in 1/5/10/30 years and what it buys, ending with 'this is what one person is doing with that idea' (the car experiment). Meta-drop that explains the project itself.
expected_value: ties directly to the car fund narrative

name: Notification Debt
concept: Estimate notifications per day and years with a smartphone. Output: total interruptions, hours of refocus time lost, presented as an invoice you never agreed to.
viral_mechanism: share card + 'send to your loudest group chat'
expected_value: productivity subreddit fit; risk: too close to DROP-001
notes: Only if DROP-001 works: same audience, different angle.
